sources.title: Job sources
sources.sub: Where this site gets its jobs, what each source did when it was last checked, and why some postings were left out.
sources.panelSub: Each source is checked on its own schedule. Numbers are from the last check, not live.
sources.empty: This site has no job source yet.

about.bank: Jobs that recruiters publish on {sourceName} for a named employer.
about.ats_public: Postings from companies' own public job boards. Each one links to the company's own page.
about.activejobs: A job search service. Used for searches people ask for.
about.jsearch: A job search service. Used for searches people ask for.
about.linkedin: A job search service that is no longer used.
about.user_import: A person pastes a link or a posting. Only that person sees it.

transport.api: Read over a secure web connection
transport.board_api: Read from each board's public job feed

reason.kill_switch: Turned off in the server settings.
reason.transport_off: Turned off in the server settings.
reason.tls_required: Its database connection is not encrypted, so we do not open it.
reason.tls_required_no_api_key: Its database connection is not encrypted and no web key is set, so we cannot read it.
reason.no_api_key: No web key is set for it.
reason.not_configured: Not set up on this server.
reason.cross_tenant_unconfirmed: Reading this source has not been confirmed for this site.
reason.wrong_market: Not a source for this site.
reason.disabled: Turned off, or its key is missing.

facts.written: Jobs saved in the last check
facts.boardsFailing: {count, plural, one {# board could not be read last time} other {# boards could not be read last time}}

notShown.title: These jobs are saved but not shown
notShown.body: {source} has no public page for a single job yet, so a person would have nowhere to apply. We keep its jobs up to date and show them once that page exists. To turn this on, set {variable} to the address of that page.
notShown.count: {count, plural, one {# published job is waiting} other {# published jobs are waiting}}

sources.pageSet: Its public job page is set. Each job links to that page.

skips.title: What the last check counted
skips.none: Nothing was left out in the last check.
skips.bank_synced: Published jobs with a named employer: {count}
skips.bank_unpublished: Open but not published by the recruiter: {count}
skips.bank_no_public_page: No public job page to link to: {count}
skips.bank_page_cap: Checks that stopped at the page limit: {count}
skips.bank_pass_cut_short: Checks that ran out of time: {count}
skips.wrong_market_intl: Located in mainland China, so not for this site: {count}
skips.missing_title_or_company: No job title or employer name: {count}
skips.private_row: Already saved privately by a user, left as it is: {count}
skips.no_external_id: No posting ID from the source: {count}
skips.board_errors: Boards that could not be read: {count}

boards.title: Company job boards
boards.sub: Public job boards of companies that hire in mainland China. We read each board's own public job feed and keep the postings located there. Every job links to the company's own page.

add.title: Add a company's job board
add.tokenHint: The company's short name in its job board address.
add.companyHint: As the company writes it on its own board.

list.title: Boards on this site
list.empty: No board yet. Add one above.
list.loadError: The list could not be loaded.

boards.offNote: Turning a board off or removing it hides its jobs. Turning it back on reads the board again.

run.queued: {company}: the board lists {listed, plural, one {# posting} other {# postings}} for this site. Reading them has started.
run.waiting: {company}: the board lists {listed, plural, one {# posting} other {# postings}} for this site. They are read at the next scheduled check.

errors.duplicate: This board is already in the list.
errors.otherSite: This board is already read for the other site, so it cannot be added here. A board is read for one site at a time.
errors.invalid: Check the board ID and the company name.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
